content:
morgan: deploy-bot: 'promotion blocked' for edge-search -> staging. deploy window in 18m. error looks like cache index drift + missing shard 404. anyone can propose quick unblock?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion halted: artifact-index checksum mismatch for edge-search:2026-03-03-rc2
```
2026-03-23T10:12:03Z ERROR PutObject shard-2 -> 404 Not Found
meta: expected-checksum=3b9f...c2, observed=UNKNOWN, cache-ttl=240s
```
alex: ugh. probably mirror rotation happened during index write. options: pin to last-green `edge-search:2026-03-01-rc7` or reupload rc2. pin is fastest for release window.
riley: +1 pin. reupload and cache-warm will likely miss the canary. If we pin, add a note in the release doc.
morgan: risk of behavior delta with rc7?
nina: rc7 had a telemetry rename behind a feature flag, no public API change. safe for staging canary.
joel (release-manager): fine to pin rc7 for this window. do pin + hold canary. i'll update release notes and open a follow-up.
alex: i'll try a parallel mirror copy of rc2 in case we want to flip post-release:
```
gsutil -m cp -r gs://artifacts-staging/tmp-edge/edge-search/rc2/* gs://artifacts-staging/mirrors/edge-search/rc2/
```
deploy-bot: action: `promote --pin edge-search:2026-03-01-rc7` executed by joel at 6212350200. Canary: held (1/3). mirror copy started.
morgan: joel please add release note: "pinned edge-search to 2026-03-01-rc7 due to artifact index/cache drift causing shard 404; rc2 mirror copy in progress; will reconcile after release window."
joel: added to release notes and changelog. follow-up ticket: https://tracker.company/RED-4012
alex: mirror copy finished and post-copy checksum for rc2 matches expected (3b9f...c2). since canary pinned, we won't flip until triage.
morgan: summary: pinned + canary held. triage tomorrow during postmortem to decide flip. closing thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
